qa.q: Do you think arguments are important?
qa.a: That depends on what you are arguing over, surely. If it's about a serious life-changing matter like financial affairs, then yes, one should have their side of things, or one should argue their side of things, absolutely. Or they could lose money and be less able to do things.

qa.q: Do you think people should change the way they think when they have arguments?
qa.a: I don't know if they can. I don't think that's a thing about human psychobiology. When you have a fight, then your critical thinking shuts down, and you want to defend your position to the last, even if you're clearly in the wrong. Although that might be a very idealised way to think about it.
